name: codex-sci-loop
description: Run native Codex phases with durable evidence, verification, audit, and recovery gates.

interface.longDescription: Codex Scientific Loop records bounded native Codex phases, reproducible verification, source diffs, explicit audit decisions, and resumable state without replacing the Codex agent runtime.
defaultPrompt: Initialize and validate the loop state for this repository.
Start one bounded phase for the active goal.
Collect evidence and prepare the current phase for audit.
Recover the current phase from durable project state.
